passages.text: Our gardening group notices that young plants bend when strong wind crosses the playground. We want to protect them without keeping the whole bed indoors. A local gardener agrees to provide some wooden supports for our experiment. We place the supports beside the plants and tie the stems loosely with soft string. Each afternoon, two pupils check that the string is not hurting the growing stems. After a windy week, we compare our notes and discuss which support worked best.

parallelText.en: Our gardening group notices that young plants bend when strong wind crosses the playground.
parallelText.zh: 我们园艺小组发现，强风吹过操场时，小植物会弯倒。

parallelText.en: We want to protect them without keeping the whole bed indoors.
parallelText.zh: 我们想保护它们，同时不把整块花坛搬到室内。

parallelText.en: A local gardener agrees to provide some wooden supports for our experiment.
parallelText.zh: 一位当地园丁同意为实验提供木支架。

parallelText.en: We place the supports beside the plants and tie the stems loosely with soft string.
parallelText.zh: 我们把支架插在植物旁，用软绳松松地绑住茎。

parallelText.en: Each afternoon, two pupils check that the string is not hurting the growing stems.
parallelText.zh: 每天下午，两位同学检查绳子有没有伤到正在生长的茎。

parallelText.en: After a windy week, we compare our notes and discuss which support worked best.
parallelText.zh: 刮风的一周过后，我们比较记录，讨论哪种支架最有效。

passages.text: Our map club is choosing a place for an imaginary walking camp. The first map shows a high hill, but the path to it is very steep. The second shows a quiet valley only twenty metres above sea level. What's more, its marked route has several sheltered places where our group could rest safely. We compare the distances and explain why the second place suits beginners better. Although the camp exists only on paper, the discussion teaches us to use several map details together.

parallelText.en: Our map club is choosing a place for an imaginary walking camp.
parallelText.zh: 我们地图社正在为一次假想徒步营选择地点。

parallelText.en: The first map shows a high hill, but the path to it is very steep.
parallelText.zh: 第一张图上有一座高山，但上山的路非常陡。

parallelText.en: The second shows a quiet valley only twenty metres above sea level.
parallelText.zh: 第二张图上是个安静山谷，只比海平面高二十米。

parallelText.en: What's more, its marked route has several sheltered places where our group could rest safely.
parallelText.zh: 更重要的是，标记路线沿途有几个遮蔽处，可让小组安全休息。

parallelText.en: We compare the distances and explain why the second place suits beginners better.
parallelText.zh: 我们比较距离，说明为什么第二处更适合初学者。

parallelText.en: Although the camp exists only on paper, the discussion teaches us to use several map details together.
parallelText.zh: 虽然营地只存在于纸上，讨论还是教会我们结合地图的多个细节。
